parameters.name: body
parameters.description: The request body for updating an AI model card. PUT uses full replacement semantics. If credit or meta is not specified, it is overwritten with the default object. The availablePaths field is overwritten as a whole list.

parameters.name: modelCardId
parameters.description: The ID of the model card to update. This ID is returned by the model creation operation and is in a format that starts with mc-.
